Create a product: a subscription, a one-time purchase or a consumable. Asks for what is missing in a
terminal.

Usage:
  voidhash product create [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --name <name>        What people see, such as Pro Monthly
      --period <weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi-annual|annual>
                           How often a subscription renews
      --perk <perk>        A perk buying it grants: its slug, name or id; repeat for each (can be
                           repeated)
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line
      --slug <slug>        How your code and the API name it (default: made from the name)
      --type <subscription|one-time|consumable>
                           Subscription (renews), one-time (kept for good) or consumable (bought
                           again and again)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash product create --name "Pro Monthly" --type subscription --period monthly --perk premium
  voidhash product create --name "Coins 100" --type consumable
